name: Password Recovery Completion Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for completing password recovery and reporting the canonical success or completion-rejected transition.
notes: The handler selects completed when PasswordManager applies the new credential and completion-rejected when the replacement fails.
PasswordRecoveryCompletionFlowHandler constants are the implementation source of truth for these canonical transition keys.

sourceReferences.note: Implemented typed handler and canonical transition keys.
